description:
FILED s473b (Opus, 2026-09-07) while shipping #1152, as its measured residue.
PRE-EXISTING; unchanged by that fix.

    my $n = 0; sub k { $n++; return "kk" }
    my $r = {}; $r->{k()} .= "z"; print $n;
        perl 1      PCL 2        <- the side effect runs twice

#1152 fixed the ELEMENT places â `%p-elem-place-p` answers for `(p-gethash C
K)` and `(p-aref C I)`, and `%p-vivified-elem-form` binds their container and
key to temps once, so `$h{k()} .= "q"`, `$a[i()] += 1` and the short-circuit
`||=` / `//=` / `&&=` now call k() once like perl.  The DEREF spellings â
`$r->{K}`, `$r->[I]`, `$$r{K}`, `$$r[I]`, which lower to `p-gethash-deref` /
`p-aref-deref` â are deliberately NOT in that predicate, because their setf
WRITERS already vivify and #1057 had no reason to touch them.  They still
expand as `(setf PLACE (op PLACE VALUE))`, so the KEY subform appears twice.

FIX SHAPE, and it is one line plus a probe: add `p-gethash-deref` and
`p-aref-deref` to `%p-elem-place-p`.  `%p-vivified-elem-form` then binds
`(cadr place)` â the REF â through `expand-autoviv`, which is the IDENTITY on
a bare symbol, so `$r->{k()} .= "z"` becomes
`(let ((cont $r) (key (k))) (setf (p-gethash-deref cont key) â¦))`.

WHAT MUST BE PROBED FIRST, and is why this was not simply folded into #1152:
when the REF is itself a chain (`$h{a}->{k()} .= 1`), `expand-autoviv` rewrites
it into `(p-autoviv-gethash %h "a")`, which returns a RAW HASH TABLE, and
`p-gethash-deref` would then be handed an aggregate where it expects a
reference.  Check that arm (it may already be right â the read path reaches it
through #1241's `p-viv-container`), and probe the four deref spellings vs
perl for both a bare-symbol ref and an element ref, plus the alias rule
(`my $al = \$r->{a}; $r->{a} .= "x"` must show through $al).

BAR when taken: the gate, the full sweep (a `cl/` change), and the bench â
`$r->{k}` compound assigns are as hot as `$h{k}` ones, and #1152's own
measurement is the recipe (runtime A/B via `BENCH_RT_B`, an `elemdot`-shaped
row, controls beside it; two extra lexical bindings measured FREE there).
subject: A compound assign over a DEREF element evaluates its KEY twice (`$r->{k()} .= "z"` calls k() twice; perl once) â #1152 fixed only the p-gethash/p-aref places
